name: Executive
description: Portfolio-level accountability. Sees every launch, approves commitments above launch-lead authority, and is the only role that may approve a governance reversal at the Launch Board.

name: Launch Lead
description: Owns delivery of an NPL end to end. May re-baseline a launch date with a reason code and impact assessment, approve resolution options within authority, and dispatch action plans. Cannot sign a batch disposition — that authority is reserved to the Qualified Person.

name: Site Planner
description: Plans and allocates capacity at one manufacturing site. May allocate supply and dispatch site tasks, but cannot re-baseline a launch date or approve a resolution option — those are cross-site consequences owned above the site.

name: Quality / Qualified Person
description: The Qualified Person under EU GMP Annex 16. The only role that may sign a batch disposition or a finished-product release, and the only role that may waive a gate criterion or close a CAPA. No agent and no other role can delegate this authority.

name: Commercial
description: Owns market commitments, launch sequence and pack-mix decisions. May commit a market and change a launch wave, but has no quality or supply-allocation authority — a commercial commitment cannot move a batch.

name: Auditor
description: Reads everything, including the immutable audit trail and the e-signature register, and writes nothing. Holds strictly more read privilege than a Site Planner and strictly less write privilege than any other role — which is why privileges are separate keys rather than one access level, since a monotonic level could not express that shape.
